name: Ball Packaging Products
old_description: Since 2011, The Ball Foundation, the philanthropic extension of Ball Corporation, has amplified Ball’s organizational values through community partnerships. Today, The Ball Foundation supports over 15 community organizations dedicated to recycling education and infrastructure; science, technology, engineering and mathematics in manufacturing; and disaster relief and preparedness.
about:
Ball Packaging Products, operating as part of Ball Corporation, is headquartered in Westminster, Colorado. The company maintains a global manufacturing footprint spanning 65-plus plants across 49 countries, with a workforce of approximately 16,000 employees. While the exact founding date of the corporation is not provided in the source material, the business has grown into a major supplier of aluminum packaging.

The company produces aluminum beverage cans, bottles, aerosol cans, ends, and aerosol containers for a range of consumer occasions. Its manufacturing scale is substantial: more than 108 billion units are shipped annually. The product portfolio includes standard and specialty cans for beer, water, and soda, as well as aluminum bottles designed for sporting events and concert venues. A second-generation ReAl® aerosol container technology targeting 75 percent recycled content is slated for launch by 2030.

Primary customers are in the beverage industry, including brands packaging beer, water, and carbonated soft drinks. The company also serves the aerosol market and partners with venues such as stadiums and concert halls. Beyond commercial sales, Ball collaborates with supply-chain partners to advance recycling infrastructure and has set a 2030 goal of achieving a 90 percent global recycling rate for aluminum beverage cans, bottles, and cups, along with an 85 percent average recycled content in its aluminum feedstock.

The Ball Foundation, established in 2011, extends the company’s community impact through grants focused on recycling education, STEM in manufacturing, and disaster relief. The corporation states that its differentiation lies in global scale, sustainability commitments, and innovations such as digital printing on cans and the ReAl® aerosol technology.
